name: Curling Iron
description: Guidelines for traveling with curling iron in your luggage.

carryOn.reason: Electric curling irons are allowed in carry-on and checked bags. Gas/butane-powered curling irons are allowed in carry-on only (must have a safety cover over heating element).

checkedBag.reason: Butane/gas-powered curling irons are prohibited in checked baggage holds. Electric curling irons are allowed in checked bags.

tsa.pageTitle: Can I bring curling iron on a plane?

travelTips: Electric curling irons are allowed in carry-on and checked bags. Gas/butane-powered curling irons are allowed in carry-on only (must have a safety cover over heating element).

faq.question: Is curling iron allowed in carry-on bags?
faq.answer: Curling Iron is allowed in carry-on luggage. Electric curling irons are allowed in carry-on and checked bags. Gas/butane-powered curling irons are allowed in carry-on only (must have a safety cover over heating element).

faq.question: Can you pack curling iron in checked baggage?
faq.answer: No, Curling Iron is not allowed in checked bags. Butane/gas-powered curling irons are prohibited in checked baggage holds. Electric curling irons are allowed in checked bags.
